open_issues.team_reply_2026-11-12: Reported (mobile team via Amir): all legacy events removed from the mobile app; registration_completed, kyc_completed, login_completed, withdrawal_completed, passcode_enabled, bank_account_added are fired from the backend only.
open_issues.hypothesis_v2_2026-11-12: Inferred: the doubling happens in the backend's GA4 sending, and only for these events. Evidence (Observed, GA4): it is event-specific, not dispatch-wide — withdrawal_completed is ~2x withdrawal_settled (1,774 vs 933 in Nov 4-10) although both are backend events for the same withdrawals; deposit_success and investment_completed are not doubled. Ratios hold in the clean Nov 4-10 week (kyc_completed/kyc_started 1.65, withdrawal_completed/withdrawal_started 1.86), so they are not a window artifact. Also login_completed exceeds session_start 1.39x. Candidates: (a) the account/identity events go through a different GA4 sender than the money events, which sends app users' events twice (e.g. to both the app stream and the web stream, or once with app_instance_id and once with client_id); (b) these events are emitted at two points (two listeners, queue retries without idempotency, two endpoints the app calls). Less likely: (c) intermediate app versions still in use fire client copies under the new names.
